--------------------------- MODULE W4Od8m7p2t2 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Instances, Total, MaxV, NULL

VARIABLES
    avail,     \* seats currently available
    reserved,  \* seats currently reserved
    ver,       \* CAS version stamp of the shared seat register
    staged     \* staged[i]: instance i's read-modify [base, op], or NULL

vars == <<avail, reserved, ver, staged>>

Bump == IF ver < MaxV THEN ver + 1 ELSE MaxV

TypeOK ==
    /\ avail \in 0 .. Total
    /\ reserved \in 0 .. Total
    /\ ver \in 0 .. MaxV
    /\ staged \in [Instances -> ([base : 0 .. MaxV, op : {"reserve", "release"}] \cup {NULL})]

Init ==
    /\ avail = Total
    /\ reserved = 0
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ staged = [i \in Instances |-> NULL]

\* An instance reads the register's version and stages a reserve or release.
Read(i, o) ==
    /\ staged[i] = NULL
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![i] = [base |-> ver, op |-> o]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<avail, reserved, ver>>

\* Compare-and-swap: apply atomically only if the version still matches.
CAS(i) ==
    /\ staged[i] # NULL
    /\ staged[i].base = ver
    /\ (staged[i].op = "reserve" => avail > 0)
    /\ (staged[i].op = "release" => reserved > 0)
    /\ avail' = IF staged[i].op = "reserve" THEN avail - 1 ELSE avail + 1
    /\ reserved' = IF staged[i].op = "reserve" THEN reserved + 1 ELSE reserved - 1
    /\ ver' = Bump
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![i] = NULL]

Fail(i) ==
    /\ staged[i] # NULL
    /\ staged[i].base # ver
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![i] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<avail, reserved, ver>>

Cancel(i) ==
    /\ staged[i] # NULL
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![i] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<avail, reserved, ver>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances, o \in {"reserve", "release"} : Read(i, o)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : CAS(i) \/ Fail(i) \/ Cancel(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Conservation: available plus reserved seats always equals the starting total,
\* since a compare-and-swap only moves one seat between the two pools.
Conservation ==
    avail + reserved = Total

=========================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Instances = {I1, I2}
    Total = 3
    MaxV = 3
    NULL = NULL
INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
A university course-registration system tracks seats in a shared compare-and-
swap register that splits them between an available pool and a reserved pool.
Two independent instances share the register. An instance reads the register's
version stamp and stages either a reserve or a release. It then performs a
compare-and-swap that applies the operation atomically -- moving one seat from
available to reserved, or back -- but only if the version still matches what it
read; each successful swap bumps the version. If the version has moved, the
swap fails, and a staged operation may also be cancelled. SAFETY PROPERTY: the
number of available seats plus the number of reserved seats always equals the
starting total, because a swap only moves a single seat between the two pools
and never creates or destroys one.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od4m6p4t2 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Cars, Instances, Cap, MaxClock, Dur, NULL

VARIABLES
    lease,     \* lease[c]: expiry time of car c's bay lease, or NULL
    clock,     \* current time
    granting,  \* granting[i]: car instance i is in the middle of granting, or NULL
    waiting    \* cars that have arrived and requested a bay

vars == <<lease, clock, granting, waiting>>

Live(c) == IF lease[c] = NULL THEN FALSE ELSE lease[c] > clock
Free(c) == IF lease[c] = NULL THEN TRUE ELSE lease[c] <= clock
Active == {c \in Cars : Live(c)}
ActiveCount == Cardinality(Active)

TypeOK ==
    /\ lease \in [Cars -> (0 .. (MaxClock + Dur)) \cup {NULL}]
    /\ clock \in 0 .. MaxClock
    /\ granting \in [Instances -> Cars \cup {NULL}]
    /\ waiting \subseteq Cars

Init ==
    /\ lease = [c \in Cars |-> NULL]
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ granting = [i \in Instances |-> NULL]
    /\ waiting = {}

Arrive(c) ==
    /\ c \notin waiting
    /\ waiting' = waiting \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, clock, granting>>

\* Either shared instance begins granting a bay to a waiting, unleased car.
Request(i, c) ==
    /\ granting[i] = NULL
    /\ c \in waiting
    /\ Free(c)
    /\ granting' = [granting EXCEPT ![i] = c]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, clock, waiting>>

\* Grant a fresh lease only if the active-lease count is below capacity.
Grant(i) ==
    /\ granting[i] # NULL
    /\ ActiveCount < Cap
    /\ Free(granting[i])
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![granting[i]] = clock + Dur]
    /\ granting' = [granting EXCEPT ![i] = NULL]
    /\ waiting' = waiting \ {granting[i]}
    /\ UNCHANGED clock

\* Time advances; leases whose expiry has passed become inactive.
Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, granting, waiting>>

Release(c) ==
    /\ lease[c] # NULL
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![c] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, granting, waiting>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Arrive(c) \/ Release(c)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, c \in Cars : Request(i, c)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Grant(i)
    \/ Tick

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Bounded capacity is never exceeded: the number of cars holding an unexpired
\* bay lease never exceeds the wash line's capacity.
BoundedCapacity ==
    ActiveCount <= Cap

=========================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Cars = {a1, a2, a3}
    Instances = {I1, I2}
    Cap = 2
    MaxClock = 2
    Dur = 1
    NULL = NULL
INVARIANT BoundedCapacity
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line assigns wash bays using lease-based ownership with
expiry: each granted lease carries an expiry time, and a lease whose expiry has
passed is no longer active. A car arrives and requests a bay. Two independent
instances share the request pool: either may begin granting a bay to a waiting
car whose lease is absent or already expired. A fresh lease -- expiring a fixed
duration in the future -- is granted only while the number of active leases is
below the line's capacity. Time advances, and leases silently become inactive
once their expiry passes; a car's lease may also be released early. SAFETY
PROPERTY: the number of cars holding an unexpired bay lease never exceeds the
wash line's bounded capacity.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od7m1p4t3 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS C, M, Cap, NULL

Cranes == 1 .. C
Containers == 1 .. M
Weight(m) == IF m = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 1

VARIABLES
    token,    \* ring position 1..C of the crane holding the load token
    loaded,   \* containers loaded onto the ship
    request,  \* pending load requests
    slow      \* cranes that are currently slow (delayed, but not failed)

vars == <<token, loaded, request, slow>>

RECURSIVE Weigh(_)
Weigh(n) == IF n = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE (IF n \in loaded THEN Weight(n) ELSE 0) + Weigh(n - 1)
LoadWeight == Weigh(M)

TypeOK ==
    /\ token \in Cranes
    /\ loaded \subseteq Containers
    /\ request \subseteq Containers
    /\ slow \subseteq Cranes

Init ==
    /\ token = 1
    /\ loaded = {}
    /\ request = {}
    /\ slow = {}

Request(m) ==
    /\ m \notin request
    /\ m \notin loaded
    /\ request' = request \cup {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, loaded, slow>>

\* The load token circulates; a slow crane simply passes it along.
PassToken ==
    /\ token' = (token % C) + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<loaded, request, slow>>

\* Only the token holder, and only if it is not slow, may load a container,
\* and only if the container still fits the ship's remaining capacity.
Load(cr, m) ==
    /\ cr = token
    /\ cr \notin slow
    /\ m \in request
    /\ m \notin loaded
    /\ LoadWeight + Weight(m) <= Cap
    /\ loaded' = loaded \cup {m}
    /\ request' = request \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, slow>>

Slowdown(cr) ==
    /\ cr \notin slow
    /\ slow' = slow \cup {cr}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, loaded, request>>

\* A slow crane recovers -- it was never failed, only delayed.
Speedup(cr) ==
    /\ cr \in slow
    /\ slow' = slow \ {cr}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, loaded, request>>

Unload(m) ==
    /\ m \in loaded
    /\ loaded' = loaded \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, request, slow>>

Next ==
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E m \in Containers : Request(m) \/ Unload(m)
    \/ \E cr \in Cranes : Slowdown(cr) \/ Speedup(cr)
    \/ \E cr \in Cranes, m \in Containers : Load(cr, m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Bounded capacity is never exceeded: the total weight of loaded containers,
\* summed directly over the loaded set, never exceeds the ship's capacity.
BoundedCapacity ==
    LoadWeight <= Cap

=========================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    C = 2
    M = 3
    Cap = 2
    NULL = NULL
INVARIANT BoundedCapacity
nl:
A container-ship crane yard loads containers onto a ship of bounded capacity,
and the right to load is passed around the crane ring by a single token. The
token circulates freely, and a slow crane simply passes it along. Only the crane
currently holding the token, and only when it is not slow, may load a requested
container, and only if that container's weight still fits within the ship's
remaining capacity. A crane may slow down and later speed up again -- it is
never failed, only delayed. Loaded containers may also be unloaded. SAFETY
PROPERTY: the total weight of all loaded containers, summed directly over the
loaded set, never exceeds the ship's bounded capacity.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od9m2p5t2 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Commands, Instances, Participants, NULL

VARIABLES
    status,  \* status[cmd]: "idle" | "voting"
    votes,   \* votes[cmd]: participants that have voted yes for cmd
    coord,   \* coord[cmd]: instance coordinating cmd's commit, or NULL
    log      \* ordered log of irreversibly committed shed commands

vars == <<status, votes, coord, log>>

LogSet == {log[j] : j \in 1 .. Len(log)}

TypeOK ==
    /\ status \in [Commands -> {"idle", "voting"}]
    /\ votes \in [Commands -> SUBSET Participants]
    /\ coord \in [Commands -> Instances \cup {NULL}]
    /\ log \in Seq(Commands)

Init ==
    /\ status = [cmd \in Commands |-> "idle"]
    /\ votes = [cmd \in Commands |-> {}]
    /\ coord = [cmd \in Commands |-> NULL]
    /\ log = <<>>

\* Either shared instance picks an idle command out of the pool and opens voting.
Begin(i, cmd) ==
    /\ status[cmd] = "idle"
    /\ coord[cmd] = NULL
    /\ coord' = [coord EXCEPT ![cmd] = i]
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![cmd] = "voting"]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![cmd] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED log

Vote(cmd, p) ==
    /\ status[cmd] = "voting"
    /\ p \notin votes[cmd]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![cmd] = votes[cmd] \cup {p}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<status, coord, log>>

\* Commit is irreversible and only fires if the command was never committed.
Commit(cmd) ==
    /\ status[cmd] = "voting"
    /\ votes[cmd] = Participants
    /\ cmd \notin LogSet
    /\ log' = Append(log, cmd)
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![cmd] = "idle"]
    /\ coord' = [coord EXCEPT ![cmd] = NULL]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![cmd] = {}]

Abort(cmd) ==
    /\ status[cmd] = "voting"
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![cmd] = "idle"]
    /\ coord' = [coord EXCEPT ![cmd] = NULL]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![cmd] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED log

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances, cmd \in Commands : Begin(i, cmd)
    \/ \E cmd \in Commands, p \in Participants : Vote(cmd, p)
    \/ \E cmd \in Commands : Commit(cmd) \/ Abort(cmd)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* An irreversible action happens at most once: no shed command ever appears
\* twice in the commit log, so no command is committed a second time even when a
\* duplicate two-phase-commit round is opened for it.
CommitAtMostOnce ==
    \A x, y \in 1 .. Len(log) : log[x] = log[y] => x = y

=========================================================================
nl:
A power-grid load shedder commits irreversible shed commands using two-phase
commit, with two coordinator instances sharing the pool of commands. Either
instance picks an idle command out of the pool and opens a voting round for it.
Each participant votes yes once. The command is committed -- irreversibly
appended to the commit log -- only when every participant has voted yes and the
command has never been committed before; the command then returns to idle. A
voting round may instead be aborted back to idle, and an idle command (even one
already committed) may have a fresh, duplicate voting round opened for it, though
it can never be committed a second time. SAFETY PROPERTY: no shed command ever
appears twice in the commit log, so the irreversible commit of any command
happens at most once even when a duplicate two-phase-commit round is opened.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od10m4p0t5 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Trains, Cap, NULL

VARIABLES
    granted,   \* train granted the exclusive block from the queue, or NULL
    inCS,      \* trains currently occupying the exclusive block
    queue,     \* bounded FIFO of trains requesting the block
    override   \* train the admin has force-granted the block to, or NULL

vars == <<granted, inCS, queue, override>>

QueueSet == {queue[j] : j \in 1 .. Len(queue)}
Authorized == IF override = NULL THEN granted ELSE override

TypeOK ==
    /\ granted \in Trains \cup {NULL}
    /\ inCS \subseteq Trains
    /\ queue \in Seq(Trains)
    /\ Len(queue) <= Cap
    /\ override \in Trains \cup {NULL}

Init ==
    /\ granted = NULL
    /\ inCS = {}
    /\ queue = <<>>
    /\ override = NULL

Enqueue(t) ==
    /\ t \notin QueueSet
    /\ t \notin inCS
    /\ granted # t
    /\ Len(queue) < Cap
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, t)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<granted, inCS, override>>

\* Grant the block to the head of the queue (no admin grant outstanding).
GrantFromQueue ==
    /\ granted = NULL
    /\ override = NULL
    /\ queue # <<>>
    /\ granted' = Head(queue)
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inCS, override>>

Enter(t) ==
    /\ t = Authorized
    /\ inCS = {}
    /\ inCS' = {t}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<granted, queue, override>>

Leave(t) ==
    /\ t \in inCS
    /\ inCS' = inCS \ {t}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<granted, queue, override>>

Release ==
    /\ granted # NULL
    /\ granted \notin inCS
    /\ granted' = NULL
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inCS, queue, override>>

\* The admin seizes the block directly, only while it is ungranted.
AdminGrant(t) ==
    /\ override = NULL
    /\ granted = NULL
    /\ override' = t
    /\ UNCHANGED <<granted, inCS, queue>>

AdminRelease ==
    /\ override # NULL
    /\ override \notin inCS
    /\ override' = NULL
    /\ UNCHANGED <<granted, inCS, queue>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Trains : Enqueue(t) \/ Enter(t) \/ Leave(t) \/ AdminGrant(t)
    \/ GrantFromQueue \/ Release \/ AdminRelease

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Mutual exclusion of the exclusive block: every train inside is the single
\* currently authorized train (queue grantee or admin grantee), so two trains
\* can never occupy the block at once.
MutualExclusion ==
    inCS \subseteq {Authorized}

=========================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Trains = {t1, t2, t3}
    Cap = 2
    NULL = NULL
INVARIANT MutualExclusion
nl:
A subway signalling block system grants an exclusive track block to at most one
train at a time, dispatching grants through a bounded request queue. A train
enqueues a request while the queue has room and it is not already queued, inside,
or granted. When no admin grant is outstanding, the dispatcher grants the block
to the train at the head of the queue. The authorized train -- the queue grantee,
or the admin's grantee if the admin has overridden -- may enter the block while
it stands empty, later leave, and the grant is released once its train is no
longer inside. A privileged admin may seize the block directly while it is
ungranted and later release it. SAFETY PROPERTY: every train occupying the
exclusive block is the single currently authorized train, so two trains can
never occupy the block at the same time.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od18m9p5t4 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets, Sequences

CONSTANTS Keys, MaxEpoch, MaxCap, NULL

VARIABLES
    epoch,   \* current firmware configuration epoch
    cap,     \* runtime cap on concurrently staged key burns
    staged,  \* staged[k]: epoch at which a burn of key k was staged, or NULL
    burned   \* ordered log of irreversibly burned one-time keys

vars == <<epoch, cap, staged, burned>>

BurnedSet == {burned[j] : j \in 1 .. Len(burned)}
StagedCount == Cardinality({k \in Keys : staged[k] # NULL})

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 0 .. MaxEpoch
    /\ cap \in 0 .. MaxCap
    /\ staged \in [Keys -> (0 .. MaxEpoch) \cup {NULL}]
    /\ burned \in Seq(Keys)

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ cap = MaxCap
    /\ staged = [k \in Keys |-> NULL]
    /\ burned = <<>>

\* An epoch-numbered reconfiguration bumps the epoch, staling open stagings.
Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, staged, burned>>

\* The cap on concurrently staged burns is reconfigured at runtime.
Adjust(k) ==
    /\ cap' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, staged, burned>>

\* Stage a burn of a key (even a previously burned one), recording the epoch,
\* while the number of staged burns is below the current cap.
Stage(key) ==
    /\ staged[key] = NULL
    /\ StagedCount < cap
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![key] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, cap, burned>>

\* Burn is irreversible: only with a current staging AND only if never burned.
Burn(key) ==
    /\ staged[key] # NULL
    /\ staged[key] = epoch
    /\ key \notin BurnedSet
    /\ burned' = Append(burned, key)
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![key] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, cap>>

\* A staging left stale by a reconfiguration is aborted.
Abort(key) ==
    /\ staged[key] # NULL
    /\ staged[key] # epoch
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![key] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, cap, burned>>

\* A staging for an already-burned key is cancelled.
Cancel(key) ==
    /\ staged[key] # NULL
    /\ key \in BurnedSet
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![key] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, cap, burned>>

Next ==
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E k \in 0 .. MaxCap : Adjust(k)
    \/ \E key \in Keys : Stage(key) \/ Burn(key) \/ Abort(key) \/ Cancel(key)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* An irreversible action happens at most once: no key ever appears twice in the
\* burn log, so a one-time key is burned at most once even when a duplicate,
\* possibly stale, burn is staged for it.
BurnAtMostOnce ==
    \A x, y \in 1 .. Len(burned) : burned[x] = burned[y] => x = y

=========================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Keys = {k1, k2}
    MaxEpoch = 2
    MaxCap = 2
    NULL = NULL
INVARIANT BurnAtMostOnce
nl:
A smart-home door lock network burns one-time firmware keys irreversibly, under
epoch-numbered reconfiguration. A reconfiguration bumps the current epoch and
leaves any open staging stale. The cap on the number of concurrently staged key
burns is reconfigured at runtime. A burn of a key -- even a key already burned --
may be staged, recording the current epoch, as long as the number of staged
burns is below the current cap. A key is then burned, appended irreversibly to
the burn log, only if its staging is still current for the live epoch and the
key has never been burned before. A staging left stale by a reconfiguration is
aborted, and a staging for an already-burned key is cancelled. SAFETY PROPERTY:
no key ever appears twice in the burn log, so a one-time key is burned at most
once even when a duplicate, possibly stale, burn is staged for it.

spec_text:
--------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m0p2t5 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Players, Lobbies, MaxV, NULL

VARIABLES
    loc,      \* loc[p]: lobby player p is in (NULL means lost)
    ver,      \* ver[p]: optimistic version stamp for player p
    pending,  \* a staged move [player, to, base], or NULL
    frozen    \* players the admin has frozen from optimistic moves

vars == <<loc, ver, pending, frozen>>

Bump(p) == IF ver[p] < MaxV THEN ver[p] + 1 ELSE MaxV

TypeOK ==
    /\ loc \in [Players -> Lobbies \cup {NULL}]
    /\ ver \in [Players -> 0 .. MaxV]
    /\ pending \in ([player : Players, to : Lobbies, base : 0 .. MaxV] \cup {NULL})
    /\ frozen \subseteq Players

Init ==
    /\ loc \in [Players -> Lobbies]
    /\ ver = [p \in Players |-> 0]
    /\ pending = NULL
    /\ frozen = {}

\* Optimistically read a non-frozen player's version and stage a lobby move.
Begin(p, t) ==
    /\ pending = NULL
    /\ p \notin frozen
    /\ loc[p] \in Lobbies
    /\ loc[p] # t
    /\ pending' = [player |-> p, to |-> t, base |-> ver[p]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<loc, ver, frozen>>

\* Commit only if the player's version has not moved since it was read.
Commit ==
    /\ pending # NULL
    /\ ver[pending.player] = pending.base
    /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![pending.player] = pending.to]
    /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![pending.player] = Bump(pending.player)]
    /\ pending' = NULL
    /\ UNCHANGED frozen

Retry ==
    /\ pending # NULL
    /\ ver[pending.player] # pending.base
    /\ pending' = NULL
    /\ UNCHANGED <<loc, ver, frozen>>

\* The admin forces a move, bumping the version and staling any optimistic read.
AdminMove(p, t) ==
    /\ loc[p] \in Lobbies
    /\ loc[p] # t
    /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![p] = t]
    /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![p] = Bump(p)]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, frozen>>

Freeze(p) ==
    /\ p \notin frozen
    /\ frozen' = frozen \cup {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<loc, ver, pending>>

Unfreeze(p) ==
    /\ p \in frozen
    /\ frozen' = frozen \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<loc, ver, pending>>

Next ==
    \/ Commit \/ Retry
    \/ \E p \in Players, t \in Lobbies : Begin(p, t) \/ AdminMove(p, t)
    \/ \E p \in Players : Freeze(p) \/ Unfreeze(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Conservation: every player is always in exactly one lobby and never lost,
\* since a move -- optimistic or admin-forced -- only relocates a player.
Conservation ==
    \A p \in Players : loc[p] \in Lobbies

=========================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Players = {p1, p2}
    Lobbies = {L1, L2}
    MaxV = 2
    NULL = NULL
INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker moves players between lobbies using
optimistic locking with retry, where each player carries a version stamp. A
settlement optimistically reads a non-frozen player's version and stages a move
to a different lobby. It commits only if the player's version has not moved since
it was read, relocating the player and bumping the version; otherwise it is
retried. A privileged admin may force a player's move directly, which also bumps
the version and stales any concurrent optimistic read. The admin may freeze and
later unfreeze players, blocking optimistic moves while frozen. SAFETY PROPERTY:
every player is always in exactly one lobby and is never lost, because a move --
optimistic or admin-forced -- only relocates a player and never creates or
destroys one.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od12m3p2t1 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Units, Fridges, Nodes, Majority, MaxGen, NULL

VARIABLES
    loc,          \* loc[u]: fridge holding blood unit u (NULL means lost)
    coordinator,  \* elected coordinator node, or NULL during an election
    gen,          \* current election generation
    ballots,      \* nodes that have cast a ballot this generation
    move          \* a scheduled transfer [unit, to], applied later, or NULL

vars == <<loc, coordinator, gen, ballots, move>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ loc \in [Units -> Fridges \cup {NULL}]
    /\ coordinator \in Nodes \cup {NULL}
    /\ gen \in 0 .. MaxGen
    /\ ballots \subseteq Nodes
    /\ move \in ([unit : Units, to : Fridges] \cup {NULL})

Init ==
    /\ loc \in [Units -> Fridges]
    /\ coordinator = NULL
    /\ gen = 0
    /\ ballots = {}
    /\ move = NULL

\* Failover: a new generation opens, deposing the current coordinator.
OpenGeneration ==
    /\ gen < MaxGen
    /\ gen' = gen + 1
    /\ coordinator' = NULL
    /\ ballots' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<loc, move>>

CastBallot(n) ==
    /\ coordinator = NULL
    /\ n \notin ballots
    /\ ballots' = ballots \cup {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<loc, coordinator, gen, move>>

TakeOffice(n) ==
    /\ coordinator = NULL
    /\ Cardinality(ballots) >= Majority
    /\ coordinator' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<loc, gen, ballots, move>>

\* The coordinator schedules relocating a unit to a different fridge.
Schedule(u, f) ==
    /\ coordinator # NULL
    /\ move = NULL
    /\ loc[u] \in Fridges
    /\ loc[u] # f
    /\ move' = [unit |-> u, to |-> f]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<loc, coordinator, gen, ballots>>

\* Because messages are reordered, the scheduled transfer is applied later,
\* relocating the unit -- never losing it.
Apply ==
    /\ move # NULL
    /\ loc[move.unit] \in Fridges
    /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![move.unit] = move.to]

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od11m8p4t2 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Jobs, Instances, Cap, NULL

Groups == {1, 2}
GroupOf(j) == IF j = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 2

VARIABLES
    groupLock,  \* groupLock[g]: instance holding printer-group g's coarse lock
    jobLock,    \* jobLock[j]: instance holding job j's fine lock, or NULL
    spooled,    \* jobs currently spooled to printers
    queued      \* jobs waiting to be spooled

vars == <<groupLock, jobLock, spooled, queued>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ groupLock \in [Groups -> Instances \cup {NULL}]
    /\ jobLock \in [Jobs -> Instances \cup {NULL}]
    /\ spooled \subseteq Jobs
    /\ queued \subseteq Jobs

Init ==
    /\ groupLock = [g \in Groups |-> NULL]
    /\ jobLock = [j \in Jobs |-> NULL]
    /\ spooled = {}
    /\ queued = {}

Submit(j) ==
    /\ j \notin queued
    /\ j \notin spooled
    /\ queued' = queued \cup {j}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<groupLock, jobLock, spooled>>

\* Take the coarse printer-group lock first.
LockGroup(i, g) ==
    /\ groupLock[g] = NULL
    /\ groupLock' = [groupLock EXCEPT ![g] = i]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<jobLock, spooled, queued>>

\* Only under the group lock may an instance take a job's fine lock.
LockJob(i, j) ==
    /\ groupLock[GroupOf(j)] = i
    /\ jobLock[j] = NULL
    /\ jobLock' = [jobLock EXCEPT ![j] = i]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<groupLock, spooled, queued>>

\* Spool a queued job while holding both locks, only if capacity allows.
Spool(i, j) ==
    /\ jobLock[j] = i
    /\ groupLock[GroupOf(j)] = i
    /\ j \in queued
    /\ j \notin spooled
    /\ Cardinality(spooled) < Cap
    /\ spooled' = spooled \cup {j}
    /\ queued' = queued \ {j}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<groupLock, jobLock>>

UnlockJob(i, j) ==
    /\ jobLock[j] = i
    /\ jobLock' = [jobLock EXCEPT ![j] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<groupLock, spooled, queued>>

UnlockGroup(i, g) ==
    /\ groupLock[g] = i
    /\ groupLock' = [groupLock EXCEPT ![g] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<jobLock, spooled, queued>>

Complete(j) ==
    /\ j \in spooled
    /\ spooled' = spooled \ {j}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<groupLock, jobLock, queued>>

Next ==
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : Submit(j) \/ Complete(j)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, g \in Groups : LockGroup(i, g) \/ UnlockGroup(i, g)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, j \in Jobs : LockJob(i, j) \/ Spool(i, j) \/ UnlockJob(i, j)

\* Bounded capacity is never exceeded: the number of jobs concurrently spooled
\* to printers never exceeds the spooler's capacity.
BoundedCapacity ==
    Cardinality(spooled) <= Cap

an instance must take a printer group's coarse lock first, then a job's fine

an operating room later recovers. The scheduling queue's capacity is

always in exactly one stage -- waiting, queued, in an operating room, or

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m4p5t0 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Matches, Cap, NULL

VARIABLES
    queue,      \* bounded queue of match-commit requests (a match may repeat)
    committed,  \* ordered log of irreversibly committed matches
    inflight,   \* match the matcher is currently processing, or NULL
    alive       \* whether the matcher process is up (crashes silently)

vars == <<queue, committed, inflight, alive>>

CommittedSet == {committed[j] : j \in 1 .. Len(committed)}

TypeOK ==
    /\ queue \in Seq(Matches)
    /\ Len(queue) <= Cap
    /\ committed \in Seq(Matches)
    /\ inflight \in Matches \cup {NULL}
    /\ alive \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ queue = <<>>
    /\ committed = <<>>
    /\ inflight = NULL
    /\ alive = TRUE

\* A match-commit request is queued while there is room; duplicates may pile up.
Request(m) ==
    /\ Len(queue) < Cap
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, m)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<committed, inflight, alive>>

Dequeue ==
    /\ alive
    /\ inflight = NULL
    /\ queue # <<>>
    /\ inflight' = Head(queue)
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<committed, alive>>

\* Commit is irreversible and fires only if the match was never committed.
Commit ==
    /\ alive
    /\ inflight # NULL
    /\ inflight \notin CommittedSet
    /\ committed' = Append(committed, inflight)
    /\ inflight' = NULL
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, alive>>

\* A request for an already-committed match is discarded.
Discard ==
    /\ inflight # NULL
    /\ inflight \in CommittedSet
    /\ inflight' = NULL
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, committed, alive>>

Crash ==
    /\ alive
    /\ alive' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, committed, inflight>>

Recover ==
    /\ ~alive
    /\ alive' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, committed, inflight>>

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Matches : Request(m)
    \/ Dequeue \/ Commit \/ Discard \/ Crash \/ Recover

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* An irreversible action happens at most once: no match ever appears twice in
\* the commit log, so a match is committed at most once even when duplicate
\* requests for it are queued.
CommitAtMostOnce ==
    \A x, y \in 1 .. Len(committed) : committed[x] = committed[y] => x = y

=========================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Matches = {m1, m2, m3}
    Cap = 2
    NULL = NULL
INVARIANT CommitAtMostOnce

match-commit requests through a bounded work queue. A request is queued whenever
the queue has room, and the same match may be requested more than once, so
duplicates can pile up. The single matcher process, while it is up, dequeues the
head request and holds it in flight, then commits it -- appending it
irreversibly to the commit log -- only if that match was never committed before;
a request for an already-committed match is discarded. The matcher may crash
silently at any time, halting its processing, and may later recover. SAFETY
PROPERTY: no match ever appears twice in the commit log, so a match is committed
at most once even when duplicate requests for it are queued.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od0m4p5t1 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Patients, Cap, NULL

VARIABLES
    reqs,     \* reqs[p]: outstanding surgery-start requests for p (bounded bag)
    opened,   \* ordered log of irreversibly opened surgeries
    inRoom,   \* patients whose surgery is open and in progress
    closed    \* patients whose surgery has closed

vars == <<reqs, opened, inRoom, closed>>

OpenedSet == {opened[j] : j \in 1 .. Len(opened)}

    /\ reqs \in [Patients -> 0 .. Cap]
    /\ opened \in Seq(Patients)
    /\ inRoom \subseteq Patients

    /\ opened = <<>>
    /\ inRoom = {}
    /\ closed = {}

\* and may be served in any order (messages are reordered).

    /\ reqs[p] < Cap
    /\ reqs' = [reqs EXCEPT ![p] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<opened, inRoom, closed>>

    /\ reqs[p] > 0
    /\ p \notin OpenedSet
    /\ opened' = Append(opened, p)
    /\ reqs' = [reqs EXCEPT ![p] = @ - 1]
    /\ inRoom' = inRoom \cup {p}

Drop(p) ==
    /\ reqs[p] > 0
    /\ p \in OpenedSet
    /\ reqs' = [reqs EXCEPT ![p] = @ - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<opened, inRoom, closed>>

Close(p) ==
    /\ p \in inRoom
    /\ inRoom' = inRoom \ {p}
    /\ closed' = closed \cup {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reqs, opened>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Patients : Request(p) \/ Open(p) \/ Drop(p) \/ Close(p)

\* An irreversible action happens at most once: no patient's surgery appears
\* twice in the opened log, so a surgery is opened at most once even when
\* duplicate, reordered start requests accumulate for that patient.
OpenAtMostOnce ==
    \A x, y \in 1 .. Len(opened) : opened[x] = opened[y] => x = y

requested patient may have their surgery opened next, not necessarily the
earliest-requested; opening is irreversible and appended to the opened log, but

the room. A duplicate request for an already-opened surgery is dropped, and an
in-progress surgery later closes. SAFETY PROPERTY: no patient's surgery ever
appears twice in the opened log, so a surgery is opened at most once even when
duplicate, reordered start requests accumulate for that patient.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od9m8p1t5 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Writers, MaxLog, NULL

Deltas == {1, 2}

VARIABLES
    value,       \* value of the shared load-adjustment record
    log,         \* ordered log of committed deltas
    coarseLock,  \* holder of the coarse region lock, or NULL
    fineLock     \* holder of the fine record lock, or NULL

vars == <<value, log, coarseLock, fineLock>>

RECURSIVE SumSeq(_)
SumSeq(s) == IF s = <<>> THEN 0 ELSE Head(s) + SumSeq(Tail(s))

TypeOK ==
    /\ value \in 0 .. (MaxLog * 2)
    /\ log \in Seq(Deltas)
    /\ Len(log) <= MaxLog
    /\ coarseLock \in Writers \cup {NULL}
    /\ fineLock \in Writers \cup {NULL}

Init ==
    /\ value = 0
    /\ log = <<>>
    /\ coarseLock = NULL
    /\ fineLock = NULL

\* Take the coarse region lock first.
LockCoarse(w) ==
    /\ coarseLock = NULL
    /\ coarseLock' = w
    /\ UNCHANGED <<value, log, fineLock>>

\* Only under the coarse lock may a writer take the fine record lock.
LockFine(w) ==
    /\ coarseLock = w
    /\ fineLock = NULL
    /\ fineLock' = w
    /\ UNCHANGED <<value, log, coarseLock>>

\* Apply an update only while holding BOTH locks, serialising all writers so no
\* update is lost by a concurrent read-modify-write.
Commit(w, d) ==
    /\ coarseLock = w
    /\ fineLock = w
    /\ Len(log) < MaxLog
    /\ value' = value + d
    /\ log' = Append(log, d)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseLock, fineLock>>

UnlockFine(w) ==
    /\ fineLock = w
    /\ fineLock' = NULL
    /\ UNCHANGED <<value, log, coarseLock>>

UnlockCoarse(w) ==
    /\ coarseLock = w
    /\ fineLock # w
    /\ coarseLock' = NULL
    /\ UNCHANGED <<value, log, fineLock>>

\* The admin may apply an update directly, bypassing the locks but still
\* reading and updating the authoritative current value.
AdminWrite(d) ==
    /\ Len(log) < MaxLog
    /\ value' = value + d
    /\ log' = Append(log, d)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseLock, fineLock>>

Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Writers : LockCoarse(w) \/ LockFine(w) \/ UnlockFine(w) \/ UnlockCoarse(w)
    \/ \E w \in Writers, d \in Deltas : Commit(w, d)
    \/ \E d \in Deltas : AdminWrite(d)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No lost updates: the record's value always equals the sum of every committed
\* delta in the log, so no committed update is ever lost.
NoLostUpdate ==
    value = SumSeq(log)

=========================================================================

CONSTANTS

    MaxLog = 3

hierarchical locks: a writer must take the coarse region lock first, then the
fine record lock, before it may apply an update. Holding both locks serialises
all writers, so each update reads and updates the authoritative current value
and appends its delta to the log; no concurrent read-modify-write can lose an
update. Writers release the fine and coarse locks in turn. A privileged admin
may apply an update directly, bypassing the locks, but still against the current
value. SAFETY PROPERTY: the record's value always equals the sum of every
committed delta in the log, so no committed update is ever lost.

    leader,     \* elected coordinator node, or NULL during an election
    term,       \* current election term
    votes       \* nodes that have voted this term

    /\ free \in 0 .. Total
    /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {NULL}
    /\ term \in 0 .. MaxTerm

    /\ free = Total
    /\ leader = NULL
    /\ term = 0
    /\ votes = {}

    /\ leader' = NULL
    /\ votes' = {}

    /\ n \notin votes

    /\ free' = free - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, votes>>

    /\ allocated > 0

    /\ free' = free + 1

pool and a free pool, coordinated by a leader elected among its nodes with

shifts a single segment between the two pools. SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of

    grantedEver,  \* (worker, job) pairs that ever legitimately held a fine lock
    applied,      \* (worker, job) pairs that have performed a print

Print(w, j) ==

    /\ coarse[GroupOf(j)] = w
    /\ applied' = applied \cup {<<w, j>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, grantedEver, cap>>

    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![j] = NULL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, grantedEver, applied, cap>>

    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, grantedEver, applied, cap>>

\* No action by an unauthorized or stale participant: every (worker, job) print
\* was performed by a worker that legitimately held that job's fine lock, so no
\* unauthorized worker ever prints.
NoUnauthorized ==
    applied \subseteq grantedEver

Zones == {1, 2}

    zoneLock,     \* zoneLock[z]: instance holding zone z's coarse lock, or NULL
    stationLock,  \* stationLock[s]: instance holding station s's fine lock
    waiting       \* cars waiting to be moved

    /\ loc \in [Cars -> Stations \cup {NULL}]
    /\ zoneLock \in [Zones -> Instances \cup {NULL}]
    /\ stationLock \in [Stations -> Instances \cup {NULL}]
    /\ waiting \subseteq Cars

    /\ zoneLock = [z \in Zones |-> NULL]
    /\ stationLock = [s \in Stations |-> NULL]

LockZone(i, z) ==
    /\ zoneLock[z] = NULL
    /\ zoneLock' = [zoneLock EXCEPT ![z] = i]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<loc, stationLock, waiting>>

    /\ stationLock[s] = NULL

    /\ zoneLock[ZoneOf(s)] = i
    /\ c \in waiting
    /\ loc[c] \in Stations

    /\ granted \notin inCS
    /\ granted' = NULL
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inCS, queue, slow>>

Slowdown(t) ==
    /\ t \notin slow
    /\ slow' = slow \cup {t}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<granted, inCS, queue>>

\* A slow thread recovers -- it was never failed, only delayed.
Speedup(t) ==
    /\ t \in slow
    /\ slow' = slow \ {t}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<granted, inCS, queue>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Threads : Enqueue(t) \/ Enter(t) \/ Leave(t) \/ Slowdown(t) \/ Speedup(t)
    \/ Grant \/ Release

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Mutual exclusion of the enrollment lock: every thread enrolling is the single
\* current grantee, so two threads can never enroll at the same time.
MutualExclusion ==
    inCS \subseteq {granted}

A university course-registration system grants an exclusive enrollment lock to
at most one thread at a time, dispatching grants through a bounded request
queue. A thread enqueues a request while the queue has room and it is not already
queued, enrolling, or granted. When the lock is free, the dispatcher grants it to
the thread at the head of the queue. The granted thread may enter the critical
section and enroll only if it is not currently slow, and only while the section
is empty; it later leaves, and the grant is released once its thread is no longer
enrolling. A thread may slow down and later speed up again -- it is never failed,
only delayed. SAFETY PROPERTY: every thread enrolling is the single current
grantee, so two threads can never enroll at the same time.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od1m5p2t5 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Flights, Runways, Voters, Quorum, NULL

VARIABLES
    assign,    \* assign[f]: runway flight f is assigned to (NULL means lost)
    ballot,    \* pending swap [a |-> f1, b |-> f2], or NULL
    votes,     \* voters that have approved the pending swap
    proposer   \* voter that proposed the pending swap, or NULL

vars == <<assign, ballot, votes, proposer>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ assign \in [Flights -> Runways \cup {NULL}]
    /\ ballot \in ([a : Flights, b : Flights] \cup {NULL})
    /\ votes \subseteq Voters
    /\ proposer \in Voters \cup {NULL}

Init ==
    /\ assign \in [Flights -> Runways]
    /\ ballot = NULL
    /\ votes = {}
    /\ proposer = NULL

\* A voter proposes swapping the runway assignments of two flights.
Propose(v, f1, f2) ==
    /\ ballot = NULL
    /\ f1 # f2
    /\ assign[f1] \in Runways
    /\ assign[f2] \in Runways
    /\ ballot' = [a |-> f1, b |-> f2]
    /\ proposer' = v
    /\ votes' = {v}
    /\ UNCHANGED assign

Vote(v) ==
    /\ ballot # NULL
    /\ v \notin votes
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {v}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<assign, ballot, proposer>>

\* A quorum swaps the two flights' runways -- exchanging, never dropping.
Commit ==
    /\ ballot # NULL
    /\ proposer \in votes
    /\ Cardinality(votes) >= Quorum
    /\ assign' = [assign EXCEPT ![ballot.a] = assign[ballot.b],
                                ![ballot.b] = assign[ballot.a]]
    /\ ballot' = NULL
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ proposer' = NULL

Abort ==
    /\ ballot # NULL
    /\ ballot' = NULL
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ proposer' = NULL
    /\ UNCHANGED assign

\* The admin may swap two flights' runways directly, bypassing the vote.
AdminSwap(f1, f2) ==
    /\ f1 # f2
    /\ assign[f1] \in Runways
    /\ assign[f2] \in Runways
    /\ assign' = [assign EXCEPT ![f1] = assign[f2], ![f2] = assign[f1]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ballot, votes, proposer>>

Next ==
    \/ \E v \in Voters, f1 \in Flights, f2 \in Flights : Propose(v, f1, f2)
    \/ \E v \in Voters : Vote(v)
    \/ Commit \/ Abort
    \/ \E f1 \in Flights, f2 \in Flights : AdminSwap(f1, f2)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Conservation: every flight is always assigned to exactly one runway and is
\* never lost, since a swap only exchanges two flights' runways.
Conservation ==
    \A f \in Flights : assign[f] \in Runways

nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator keeps every flight assigned to exactly one
runway, and reassignments are decided by quorum voting. A voter proposes
swapping the runway assignments of two distinct flights; other voters then
approve the pending swap. Once its proposer has voted and a quorum of approvals
is present, the two flights' runways are exchanged; a pending swap may also be
aborted. A privileged admin may swap two flights' runways directly, bypassing
the vote. Every swap only exchanges two flights' runways. SAFETY PROPERTY: every
flight is always assigned to exactly one runway and is never lost, because a
swap only exchanges assignments and never creates or destroys one.
